intro: Designed for slow mornings and unhurried nights, Mollie wraps your bedroom in upholstered softness. The serene blue fabric, adjustable headrest, and easy-lift hydraulic base makes it a must-have bed.

features.title: Fully upholstered, all-round comfort
features.text: Mollie is upholstered from headboard to base, softening every edge and giving the bed a plush, tailored presence in the room. The padded surfaces make sitting, reading, or simply leaning back feel relaxed and inviting.

features.title: Geneva blue microfibre elegance
features.text: Clad in Geneva Steel (blue) microfibre, the bed introduces a calm, bedroom-friendly hue that works beautifully with both light and dark furniture. The fabric offers a smooth hand feel and is easy to maintain.

features.title: Hydraulic storage with full-length space
features.text: A hydraulic lift mechanism reveals a full-length storage, divided by a central partition for organised stowing of bedding, suitcases, or seasonal items. Integrated handle grips and a mattress arrester help you lift and close the base smoothly while keeping the mattress securely in place.

features.title: Adjustable headrest for flexible lounging
features.text: The adjustable headrest lets you shift from flat, sleep-ready support to a more upright angle for reading, streaming, or working in bed. This flexibility allows different members of the household to find their preferred posture without adding extra pillows or wedges.

features.title: Built to be solid and long-lasting
features.text: Under the upholstery, an MDF batten-based mattress panel with non-woven cloth provides a sturdy platform to hold the mattress. Combined with quality hardware on the hydraulic system, Mollie is made to feel reassuringly stable and dependable night after night.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Mollie Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
